storyboard_arc_title: Isla keeps the day from deciding for her

storyboard_arc.setup: Isla glances at her growing to-do list, choosing to open her puzzle grid first.
storyboard_arc.disruption: As the train slows to an unexpected crawl, Isla stays focused on her puzzle.
storyboard_arc.choice: Sitting outside, she flips her phone face down to enjoy three minutes.
storyboard_arc.puzzle_moment: The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.
storyboard_arc.consequence: Her careful check pays off, making the rest of her day feel totally doable.
storyboard_arc.resolution: With the final piece in place, Isla quietly shuts her laptop and breathes easy.

captions:
Let's get a head start before the house wakes up.
Isla glances at her growing to-do list, choosing to open her puzzle grid first.

No point stressing over the delay.
As the train slows to an unexpected crawl, Isla stays focused on her puzzle.

Just three minutes to myself.
Sitting outside, she flips her phone face down to enjoy three minutes.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.
The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.

Okay, that actually fits perfectly.
Her careful check pays off, making the rest of her day feel totally doable.

Time to put this away.
With the final piece in place, Isla quietly shuts her laptop and breathes easy.
